title: ssh-key-wolfcrypt: stable deps; keep written private keys at 0600
description: Release-candidate pins moved to stable (ssh-cipher 0.3 needs its encoding feature; Mpint is infallible; TdesCbc). write_openssh_file kept existing files' permissions, so a key written over a 0644 file stayed world-readable; it now sets 0600 explicitly. The test scratch keys that were committed are no longer tracked.
